entities.title: The headless smoke test
entities.summary: A scripted game through the real input path that checks each step and exits 0 when every check passes.
criteria: The title, docking, trading, buying equipment, saving, the launch, flying, firing, the mounts, the missile and E.C.M. keys, a chart, pause and resume, a crash into the planet, death, the return to the title and loading the saved pilot each behave as checked

sources.symbol: Scripted games and the smoke test

entities.title: Screenshots of every screen
entities.summary: A scripted game that saves a screenshot of every screen for review.
criteria: Every screen renders: title, docked status, market, equipment, the charts, system data, the tunnels, the flight HUD, a fight, the countdown, pause, death and the loaded pilot's hold

checks.description: A person looks at the screenshots.
